title: DE/F3: pairs_with and referenced_by referential integrity undeclared — dangling ids would pass
description: Evidence: the draft's entries cross-reference by id (pairs_with: [hook-session-start, ...]; referenced_by: [project-settings]) and reference_surfaces by id, but no constraint declares that every referenced id must resolve within the manifest. A typo'd pair id or a deleted entry leaving danglers would validate structurally and break the session-substrate check's both-halves verification semantics silently. Fix: declare referential-integrity constraints in the schema (mdatron's narrowed DSL scope — cross-file and registry validation — covers exactly this class; until that check lands, the vsdd-side read validates). Owner: data-engineer. Validator: sanity-check (DE-internal constraint).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Resolved: referential-integrity constraints declared in the schema description and the manifest body; execution binds to the session-substrate check at read and mdatron's cross-file family at landing. Evidence: commit fdbc3dc3 (mdatron verify clean at commit time), vsdd-cli #658 trail.
